title: History Change Record
description: One flattened bug-history change record, as emitted in `bzr bug history --json` / `--output ndjson`. A history entry with N changed fields expands to N records sharing `when`/`who`/`comment_id`.

when.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the change, verbatim from the server.

who.description: The user who made the change.

field.description: The changed field name (e.g. `status`, `assigned_to`, or a `cf_*` custom field).

old_value.description: The removed value; empty string when nothing was removed.

new_value.description: The added value; empty string when nothing was added.

comment_id.description: The id of a comment posted in the same history entry (correlated by author and timestamp), or null when no comment correlates.
